theme.appearanceModeDesc: Themes that support dual modes can follow the system or be fixed to light or dark.
theme.bruiseDesc: Intentionally ugly high-saturation yellow-purple theme, hidden by default, not shown in regular theme list.
theme.cobaltDesc: Cool cobalt blue and theatre curtain modern theme, supports light, dark, and follow system.
theme.customColorLive: Custom colors applied in real time
theme.customDesc: Fully customizable personal color option to create your own style.
theme.customThemeDesc: Separate light and dark color tuning. Card preview and page theme update in real time.
theme.darkDesc: Always use the dark appearance of the Silver Mist theme
theme.emberDesc: Vibrant orange-red neon style, like stage lights and glow sticks together, fixed light appearance.
theme.followSystemDesc: Automatically match the device's current light or dark appearance
theme.frostingPinkDesc: A bolder pink stage-style look, sweet but not childish, fixed light appearance.
theme.gildedDesc: Integrated collection theme from moonlit paper to banquet gold, supports light, dark, and follow system.
theme.heroAnimDesc: Switch the hero transition animation rendering method when opening/returning from the detail page. Compositor mode has higher frame rates, layout mode has better compatibility.
theme.heroAutoDesc: Automatically select based on aspect ratio (recommended)
theme.idolDesc: High-saturation idol support style with neon and stage sign vibes, fixed light appearance.
theme.jadeDesc: Jade green and velvet texture display theme, supports light, dark, and follow system.
theme.lightDesc: Always use the light appearance of the Silver Mist theme
theme.lockedAppearance: Current theme is fixed to {appearance} appearance
theme.lockedAppearanceDesc: Only themes that support appearance switching can be set to light, dark, or follow system here. The preference will be preserved when switching back to a dual-mode theme.
theme.mintDesc: Lighter sea salt mint palette, refreshing yet preserving card layers, fixed light appearance.
theme.mistDesc: Cool silver-gray mist with glass card base theme, supports light, dark, and follow system.
theme.paperCreamDesc: Warm paper-toned base with a collection album feel, fixed light appearance.
theme.terracottaDesc: Archive style resembling a display record album, fixed light appearance.
theme.themeStyleDesc: Built-in themes come first, custom theme is pinned at the end for easy selection.
theme.title: Theme & Appearance
theme.vinylDesc: Night style leaning towards vinyl sleeves and brass lighting, fixed dark appearance.
